hero.title: Add Chahua to your home screen
hero.install: Once installed, it launches from your desktop like a native app.
hero.share: To recommend this to a friend, share the forum post URL instead of this page. This page's URL contains your account login information.

android.step3: Choose “Install and create shortcut”, then tap “Install”.
android.step4: Confirm the installation, then open it from your desktop.
android.note: If the browser shows an install prompt, just tap Install.
android.note2After: and choose “Add to phone” (it may be on the second page).

ios.step3: Choose “Add to Home Screen” (it may be under “More”).
ios.step4: Confirm, then open it from your home screen.

windows.step3: Choose “More tools” > “Apps” > “Install this site as an app”.
windows.step4: Choose where to create the icon: taskbar, Start menu, or desktop.
windows.note: If the browser shows an install button in the address bar, just tap Install.

macos.step4: Confirm, then open it from the Dock or “Apps”.

linux.note: This shouldn't be a problem for you :)
